text: ともだちと　むし　ポケモン　とりに　きてるんだ！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモン　とりに

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before come or go gives the purpose. とりに　きてる = 'have come to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ explains or stresses a reason. きてるんだ = 'the thing is, I'm here'.
